versions.localizedDescription: Notifications reach you with the app closed: the host no longer believes a stale 'I am reading this bot' claim, and the app now drops that claim when it leaves the foreground. Root cause of the replies that went missing.

App icon is now white on black, and the sideload source's icon was regenerated with it — SideStore had been showing a blue mark from before the faces existed. Same build also carries the bot's face inside Hermey's own notification banners.

Hermey's own banners now carry the bot's face: each portrait is rendered once at launch, cached, and attached to the notification. (The corner icon stays the app icon — iOS chooses it, not the app.) Bark banners unchanged.

Banners carry the bot's own face — the app renders each portrait exactly as the roster draws it and the host serves it to the relay — plus Time Sensitive. Paste Bark's URL in Settings → Notifications to turn it on.

Banners now carry the bot's own face: the app renders each portrait exactly as the roster draws it and the host serves it to the relay. Also Time Sensitive, so a reply can break through Focus. Paste Bark's URL in Settings → Notifications to turn it on.
